subject: Mythology
title: Oni: The Demon Ogres
description: A 60-second lesson on Oni: The Demon Ogres.

hook.text: Oni are massive ogres with horns, fangs, and iron clubs who punish the wicked in the Japanese underworld.

buildup.text: They come in red, blue, and green. Each color has a different personality, from rage to greed to laziness.

discovery.text: In Buddhist-influenced tales, oni are the jailers of hell, tormenting sinners as punishment for their earthly crimes.

twist.text: Some stories show oni as redeemable. The tale of the Crying Red Oni shows one sacrificing everything for a friend.

climax.text: During Setsubun, families throw beans at invisible oni shouting 'Demons out! Luck in!' to start the year.

punchline.text: Every year, Japan defeats its demons with a handful of soybeans.

quiz.question: What do Japanese families do during Setsubun to ward off oni?
options: Throw beans while shouting 'Demons out! Luck in!'
Hang special talismans above their doors
